messages:
reid (eng-ml): quick summary from the Borealis-13b bring-up int8 vs int6 yesterday. Need a short recommendation for GTN routing + canary thresholds.
maya (ml): drop the scorecard pls.
reid (eng-ml): paste smoke run highlights (4.5k sampled requests + eval slices):
```
model: borealis13b-2026-07
variants: fp16 (baseline), int8, int6
latency p50/p95 (ms): fp16 48/125, int8 51/142, int6 55/185
throughput tokens/sec: fp16 170, int8 185, int6 220
quality (QA EM / long-sum rougeL): fp16 90.8 / 38.9, int8 90.5 / 38.6, int6 89.6 / 37.8
unit cost per 1k tokens est: fp16 $0.0022, int8 $0.0015, int6 $0.00095
notes: int6 reduces token cost ~37% vs int8, but p95 tail increases noticeably on >1500 token flows and longform summary quality drops ~1.2 EM vs int8.
```
sam (prod): big cost win. which slices show the worst drops? any >2 EM?
reid (eng-ml): worst: large-document summarization (>2k tokens) ~1.2 EM drop int6 vs int8, and a niche "document-edit-rewrite" slice shows ~1.9 EM drop. Chat and short Q/A within 0.4 EM. Rerank unimpaired. No error-rate uptick.
maya (ml): my read: int6 is compelling for chat/FAQ. For long-doc and edit-heavy tasks we should keep int8. Potential mitigations: prefix-KV caching, hybrid routing (start int6 then switch to int8 after N tokens), or per-route gating.
vic (gtn): product Q: can we default new GTN tenants to int6 and escalate to int8 for long-doc detection? or is staged rollout safer?
sam (prod): staged is safer. propose: default route mapping for new tenants = int8 (standard), allow opt-in eco=int6 with recommended per-route restrictions. Run canary to validate.
reid (eng-ml): proposed operational plan:
- Canary: 48h, 20% traffic, stratified across slices
- Probes: 180 chat prompts, 80 long-doc summaries, 40 document-edit tests; cadence 5m
- Rollback triggers: any probe category EM drop >1.25 sustained 20m OR p95 latency increase >45% sustained 20m -> rollback route to int8
- Auto-fallback: per-request detection (token length or route tag) to divert to int8 for long-docs
- Console: log token-econ delta + per-probe quality timeseries
- UX: GTN defaults: standard=int8, eco=int6 opt-in, fidelity=fp16 for pinned high-risk routes
infra-bot: canary created id=br-5098, start=2026-07-22T02:00:00Z, traffic=20%, fallback=int8, alert-channel=#eng-ml-ops
maya (ml): I'll build the probe set and the realtime delta dashboard. also will run a replay sim for the hybrid rule overnight.
sam (prod): add human review for document-edit samples every 3h during canary. also include sample diffs in the experiment panel.
vic (gtn): i'll draft GTN advisory copy: "Recommendation: Default standard=int8. Offer eco=int6 opt-in for chat-first tenants; route long-docs and edit-heavy tasks to int8 or fp16." will share for review.
reid (eng-ml): decision: proceed with canary per infra-bot. if 48h snapshot is green, we recommend opt-in eco for managed GTN tenants and update onboarding docs. will follow up with rollout checklist and replay sim output.
maya (ml): noted 44d will post dashboard link when available.
sam (prod): thanks team.
reid (eng-ml): closing thread 4cc
